sections.heading: The custom application advantage
sections.subheading: Bespoke software built around your exact workflows, customer journeys, and commercial goals.
sections.introSuffix: requires technology tailored to its unique business model. Off-the-shelf templates and simple web wrappers cannot support proprietary algorithms, complex multi-user roles, real-time dispatch, or custom payment logic.

outcomes.title: Bespoke User Experiences
outcomes.desc: Tailored customer and staff workflows with native iOS and Android gesture response, offline reliability, and lightning performance.

outcomes.title: Scalable Cloud Architecture
outcomes.desc: Robust backend APIs, relational databases, and automated backups built to effortlessly scale from hundreds to hundreds of thousands of users.

outcomes.title: Seamless Local & Global Payments
outcomes.desc: Direct integrations with Ghanaian payment rails (MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash) alongside Visa/Mastercard via Paystack or Flutterwave.

sections.heading: Complimentary architecture & tech consultation
sections.subheading: Two valuable advisory sessions before entering technical scoping and wireframe design.

cards.title: App Technical Architecture & Scope Review
cards.desc: A deep-dive technical assessment evaluating database architecture, third-party APIs, and security requirements.
items: Review of proposed feature requirements and user personas
Selection of optimal tech stack (Flutter / React Native cross-platform)
Assessment of third-party API dependencies (maps, SMS, payments)
Recommended milestone roadmap and MVP scoping outline

cards.title: 30-Min Wireframe & Tech Stack Demo
cards.desc: An interactive screen presentation demonstrating similar app architectures and administrative backends.
items: Demonstration of real-time cloud database syncing and push alert triggers
Walkthrough of web admin dashboard capabilities and exportable reports
Review of payment gateway settlement directly into your corporate account
Open technical Q&A for founders, directors, and technical leads

sections.footer: Consultations are provided to startups, commercial businesses, and corporate organizations across Ghana.

sections.heading: Choose your custom application tier
sections.subheading: Three transparent tiers reflecting the exact scope, technical depth, and development timeframes from our proven framework.

tiers.title: The MVP (Minimum Viable Product)
tiers.desc: A simple, single-purpose application engineered for fast market validation without complex backend overhead.
items: Single-purpose mobile app (e.g., church app with sermons/notices, or basic business directory)
3–5 custom UI/UX screens with modern responsive layout
Basic user authentication (email/password or phone login)
Lightweight backend database & content management
Cross-platform compilation for Android and iOS
App Store and Google Play packaging and release build testing
30 days post-launch technical warranty and handover
tiers.footNote: Ideal for startups validating an idea, specialized directories, and community organization apps.

tiers.recommendLabel: Recommended for scaling businesses & commercial portals
tiers.title: The Standard Business App
tiers.desc: An application that solves a specific business problem with member accounts, notifications, and existing database/API connections.
items: Solves a specific business problem (e.g., real estate listing app, school portal, fleet delivery app)
Comprehensive user profiles, roles, and account preferences
Push notifications engine with targeted message broadcasts
Search, multi-attribute filtering & saved favorites/bookmarks
Direct integration with existing business database, CRM, or REST/GraphQL API
Secure session management with token-based API authentication
Web-based management dashboard for administrative team
60 days dedicated technical warranty, staff training & documentation
tiers.footNote: Engineered for established businesses automating customer transactions or field workforce operations.

tiers.title: The Advanced Platform
tiers.desc: A complex, fully-featured commercial ecosystem with real-time tracking, payment integrations, and custom admin portals.
items: Complex, fully-featured platform (e.g., e-commerce marketplace, fintech wallet, ride-hailing/logistics app)
Advanced security, end-to-end data encryption & biometric authentication
Real-time GPS tracking, live map routing, and driver/courier dispatch interfaces
Complete payment gateway integration (Paystack, Flutterwave, MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, Cards)
Comprehensive Web Admin Dashboard with financial analytics, audit logs, and exportable reports
Automated SMS & WhatsApp transactional alert triggers
Multi-tenant or multi-role hierarchy (Admin, Vendor, Driver, Customer)
Scalable cloud deployment (AWS / DigitalOcean) with automated daily backups
90 days dedicated technical warranty, SLA support & developer knowledge transfer
tiers.footNote: Built for mission-critical digital products demanding high concurrency, military-grade security, and automated payments.

enterprise.heading: National-Scale Enterprise & Government Deployments
enterprise.body: For high-volume financial institutions, telecom value-added services, or national logistics networks requiring high-availability microservices architecture, automated penetration testing, and 24/7 dedicated DevOps monitoring.

sections.smallNote: All custom app projects include 100% intellectual property transfer, clean documented source code, and zero vendor lock-in.

sections.heading: Platform scalability upgrades
sections.subheading: High-impact modules that can be added to any custom mobile application tier.

tiers.title: In-App Chat & Customer Support Engine
tiers.desc: Enable real-time 1-on-1 or group messaging between customers, support agents, or field personnel.
items: WebSockets / Firebase real-time instant messaging engine
Image, document, and audio voice note attachment sharing
Message read receipts, typing indicators, and push alerts
Admin moderation panel with chat transcript history
tiers.footNote: Essential for marketplace negotiation, doctor-patient consultation, and rider-driver coordination.

tiers.title: Automated In-App Wallet & Escrow Ledger
tiers.desc: A virtual digital wallet system allowing users to hold balances, make instant in-app payments, and withdraw to MoMo.
items: Double-entry bookkeeping financial ledger architecture
Instant wallet top-up via Mobile Money and Credit/Debit Card
Automated payout API for technician, vendor, or driver withdrawals
Transaction history with downloadable PDF receipts and tax statements
tiers.footNote: Eliminates payment friction and enables recurring transactions without re-entering card details.

sections.smallNote: Upgrades are scoped collaboratively and integrated directly into the core app sprint schedule.

sections.heading: DevOps, infrastructure & growth services
sections.subheading: Enterprise cloud management and ongoing product engineering support.

items.title: Cloud Infrastructure Setup (AWS / DigitalOcean)
items.body: Production server provisioning, SSL certificates, load balancers, and managed PostgreSQL/MongoDB database deployment with automated backups.

items.title: SMS & WhatsApp Transactional Gateway Setup
items.body: Integration with Ghanaian bulk SMS providers for instant one-time passwords (OTP), login verification codes, and booking confirmation alerts.

items.title: App Store Optimization & Launch Marketing
items.body: App store screenshot design, localized keywords, privacy policy drafting, and launch-day submission coordination.

items.title: Monthly Feature Sprint & DevOps Retainer
items.body: Continuous engineering support providing dedicated developer hours each month for new features, OS upgrades, and security patches.

sections.footer: Cloud hosting subscriptions and third-party SMS/payment provider fees are billed transparently at direct cost.

sections.heading: Four-phase agile engineering roadmap
sections.subheading: A disciplined, milestone-driven software development lifecycle guaranteeing quality and transparency.

steps.title: Architecture & UI/UX Wireframing
steps.desc: We define the database schema, map user journeys, design high-fidelity Figma screens, and finalize technical API specifications.

steps.title: Core Sprint Development
steps.desc: Our team builds the frontend mobile interfaces, engineers backend API endpoints, and connects database models in weekly sprints.

steps.title: End-to-End Testing & Security Audit
steps.desc: We conduct rigorous functional testing, stress-test server loads, simulate real-world network latency, and audit payment security.

steps.title: App Store Publishing & Handover
steps.desc: We deploy the production cloud environment, submit release builds to Google Play and Apple App Store, and train your administrative team.

sections.heading: Commercial terms and IP ownership
sections.subheading: Complete intellectual property transfer, milestone-governed payments, and clear SLAs.

terms.title: Milestone-based payments
terms.body: 50% upfront commitment to initiate architectural wireframing and server provisioning, 30% upon approval of the working staging beta build, and 20% prior to final production deployment.

terms.title: 100% Intellectual Property Ownership
terms.body: Upon final settlement, all custom source code, database architectures, graphics, and server configurations belong exclusively to your organization.

terms.title: Transparent Cloud & Third-Party Billing
terms.body: Cloud server hosting (AWS/DigitalOcean) and payment gateway processing fees are paid directly to providers without agency markup.

terms.title: Dedicated Technical Warranty
terms.body: Includes 60 to 90 days of complimentary bug resolution, crash monitoring, and server performance tuning post-launch.

callout.label: Custom Engineering Guarantee:
callout.body: Every custom application is built from scratch with clean, documented code and modular architecture to ensure your in-house developers or future partners can easily extend the platform.

sections.heading: Next steps to engineer your custom app
sections.subheading: Partner with Web-App to build high-performance mobile software that scales your business.
paragraphs: We recommend The Standard Business App tier at GH₵18,000 – 30,000 for established businesses seeking to automate operational workflows, connect existing databases, and engage users with targeted notifications. For startups launching a focused first release, The MVP at GH₵8,000 – 15,000 provides fast market entry in 3–5 weeks. For complex multi-sided ecosystems, The Advanced Platform at GH₵35,000 – 60,000+ delivers enterprise-grade performance.
To get started, simply reply to confirm your preferred tier or schedule your complimentary 30-minute architecture consultation.
